authorization_scope: single preregistered empirical campaign using the frozen CL-003 protocol and its complete preregistered seed/condition set
authorization_constraints: The runner must verify every SHA-256 entry from the referenced freeze manifest before loading empirical data.
Any freeze mismatch blocks execution and requires a new explicit freeze and authorization record before empirical rerun.
All preregistered seeds and conditions must be retained; aborted runs are handled only by the preregistered missing-data policy.
Execution produces DATA and a machine report only; it does not create EVID or change hypothesis/claim status automatically.
Any scientifically relevant protocol change requires a new experiment identifier rather than modification of this frozen campaign.
